mapper.select: select id, activityname, activityimg, activitydescribe, createtime, createname, click from 0721acgn.tb_activity where id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE 0721acgn.tb_activity SET click = COALESCE(click, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 0721acgn.tb_activity_daily_views (activity_id, view_date, views) VALUES (#{id}, DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE views = views + 1
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.activityname, SUM(v.views) AS click FROM 0721acgn.tb_activity_daily_views v JOIN 0721acgn.tb_activity a ON a.id = v.activity_id WHERE v.view_date >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) - INTERVAL 6 DAY GROUP BY a.id, a.activityname ORDER BY click DESC, a.id LIMIT 9
